crossRefs.note: “ ‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand…
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

translations.web: “ ‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’ ”
translations.bsb: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.”
translations.kjv: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
translations.asv: This is the law of the Nazirite who voweth, and of his oblation unto Jehovah for his separation, besides that which he is able to get: according to his vow which he voweth, so he must do after the law of his separation.
